notes.title: Update notes for June 18, 2025
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed racing wheels not working at the beginning of races when using analog inputs.

notes.title: Classic racers FlatOut 1 & 2 get improved controller support, better widescreen and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Classic racing games FlatOut 1 & 2 just got upgraded, and there's also a small update for FlatOut: Ultimate Carnage too.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/06/classic-racers-flatout-1-2-get-improved-controller-support-better-widescreen-and-bug-fixes/

notes.title: Improved controller support, better widescreen, and bug fixes!
notes.notes: [h1]Changelog[/h1][list][*][p]Improved controller support.[/p][list][*][p]Added native support for Xbox, PlayStation, and Nintendo controllers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed analog controls.[/p][/*][*][p]Fully rebindable controller buttons.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved widescreen support.[/p][list][*][p]Improved FOV implementation. The FOV can now be configured by editing zoom_fo2.cfg.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed all menus, in-game UI, and graphics for 16:9, 16:10, and 21:9.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed extreme camera zoom out when boosting.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed workshop mods not applying on Linux/Steam Deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed crashes on Windows 11.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Modding notes:[/h3][list][*][p]All .bed files located in the data/menu and data/scripts are now loaded per aspect ratio.[/p][list][*][p]16:9, 21:9 and 16:10 aspect ratios will use files in data/scripts/{aspect_ratio}, data/scripts/{aspect_ratio}, etc.[/p][/*][*][p]The supported aspect ratio folders are 16_9 for 16:9, 21_9 for 21:9 and 16_10 for 16:10.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]A selection of TGA files are now loaded per aspect ratio.[/p][list][*][p]16:9, 21:9 and 16:10 aspect ratios will use the data/menu/filename_{aspect_ratio}.tga files.[/p][/*][*][p]The supported aspect ratio postfixes are _169 for 16:9, _219 for 21:9 and _1610 for 16:10.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Jul 24
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed game launching in the background for some users.
[*]Fixed languages not working if the Steam client didn't match the chosen language.
    Language selection on Steam is now done via the game properties.
[/list]
[b][url=https://help.steampowered.com/faqs/view/4984-C127-121D-B3F2]Changing Language[/url][/b]
[olist]
[*]Right click the game title and select [b]Properties...[/b]
[*]Go to the [b]Language[/b] tab.
[*]Select the language you wish to use from the drop-down menu.
[/olist]
